lxc_3845e82077db4116.text: Dogs, cats, goldfish, and birds are common pets.

lxc_f0eafecdb3f1b826.text: Hermit crabs are a fun, unusual choice, and pet choices can differ from country to country.

lxc_4335262d93624f52.text: A pet is an animal that people keep for company or fun.

lxc_2f57c0c9deb689a5.text: Dogs and cats are very popular pets.

lxc_c3dd548fcb431e19.text: Fish and birds are common pets too.

lxc_cae66aa689c82a93.text: People may want a pet for friendship, beauty, or help protecting a home.

lxc_bed2b3c684925dc9.text: When we compare pets, we can ask three simple questions: Does it fit the home?

lxc_10529ef0845597b2.text: How much time does it need?

lxc_1e4ca1ee6eb4a85f.text: Why does the person want it?

lxc_86a957c31803a7ee.text: Dogs often live closely with people.

lxc_a5f49bbf4d6c933f.text: Many people enjoy playing with them and taking them for walks.

lxc_419a0e25b1015b79.text: Cats also give people company, but they can be quieter at home.

lxc_7642dd40fab317b0.text: Cats can live indoors and usually need less outdoor walking than many dogs.

lxc_6c1484e57a846cdc.text: For example, a busy person in an apartment may prefer a cat, while an active family may enjoy walking with a dog.

lxc_7882c057f769fab9.text: A goldfish is a freshwater fish often kept in an indoor aquarium, a glass home for fish.

lxc_3f8cb445a737cdfc.text: Goldfish were first bred for color in China and later spread to other countries.

lxc_2b6795824a398ce7.text: Birds can also be colorful companions.

lxc_bb5d50b62d6e64a0.text: Budgies and cockatiels are popular pet birds.

lxc_c406a82cefbcbf71.text: People may choose birds for their company, color, or song.

lxc_cede413e0aa97627.text: Both fish and birds can bring beauty into a home.

lxc_b16d7f9e25b24d05.text: Some people keep hermit crabs as pets.

lxc_413f074c80511804.text: A hermit crab can be a fun or unusual choice because it is very different from a dog, cat, fish, or bird.

lxc_511b23caed10409f.text: Here, unusual does not mean bad.

lxc_4943982a8d457532.text: It means that fewer people first think of this animal when they hear the word “pet.”

lxc_28adbc1c906899fe.text: A person may choose one because they enjoy small and interesting animals.

lxc_8226e69417d57b44.text: People in different countries may choose different pets because their homes, daily routines, and reasons are different.

lxc_372f4019d5ebd6ad.text: Imagine one person in a small apartment and another person in a house with more outdoor space.

lxc_41943c03475c3df5.text: The first person may choose a goldfish or cat.

lxc_4517105871e7c5da.text: The second may choose a dog for walks and play.

lxc_da0be78fe6b60eea.text: Some people want friendship, while others enjoy an animal’s beauty or want help protecting a home.

lxc_466ec35b2a4caf18.text: A popular pet is not always the right pet for every person.

lxc_ff759f22462436e8.text: It is important to think again about home, time, and reason.

lxc_b0c928ddca6bb725.text: A dog may suit someone who enjoys daily walks.

lxc_904278bfafd64b0b.text: A cat may suit a quieter indoor home.

lxc_dd2c73fc0422b254.text: A goldfish needs an aquarium, and a bird may interest someone who likes color and song.

lxc_c2ba881bdd2be7de.text: Someone who wants a less common animal may think about a hermit crab.
